steps.title: A cache miss reads D1 once, then caches the row
steps.line: Lines 4 to 6 read D1, put the row in KV for 300 s, return it.
steps.caption: KV has no entry, so past the lookup getUser runs on into the outlined lines, which only a miss reaches: it reads the row from D1, puts it in KV for 300 seconds and returns it. Lookups for the same user in that window are hits; D1 still serves every miss.
